DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0530] config | broker.timeout_ms | version 4.x
# `broker.timeout_ms`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Time in milliseconds that the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10000` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | broker |
| Unit | ms |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `broker.timeout_ms` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[broker]
timeout_ms = 10000
```

---

[d0531] config | replicator.timeout_ms | version 4.x
# `replicator.timeout_ms`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | ms |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `replicator.timeout_ms` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
timeout_ms = 5000
```
